title: CRLR/237/2014 of Chotu Alias Arif Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND THROUGH SECRETARY HOME, SECRETARIAT COMPLEX,DEHRADUN

paras.text:
CRLR No.237 of 2014
Hon'ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Mohd. Azim, Advocate for the
revisionist.
 Mr. S.T. Bhardwaj, Deputy Advocate
General with Mr. V.S. Rathour, Brief Holder,
for the State.
 Notices were issued to the respondent
no.2 vide order dated 08.10.2014, but no one
has put in appearance before this Court.
 The office report shows that the service
has been held sufficient upon the respondent
no.2. Despite the service upon the
respondent no.2 long back, he is not
appearing before this Court.
 Heard learned Counsels for the parties.
 The learned Counsel for the revisionist
submits that the revisionist was convicted
and sentenced for only one month and the
penalty of Rs.1,00000/- (Rupee One Lakh
Only) was imposed upon the revisionist has
already been deposited, which shall be
received by the complainant.
 Having considered the facts and
circumstances of the case and the fact that
the revisionist has been convicted merely for
a period of one month and the penalty has
already been deposited by the revisionist, no
fruitful purpose will be solved to keep this
matter pending before this Court. Sentence
awarded to the revisionist is hereby set
aside.
 Accordingly, the criminal revision is
allowed.
